description.summary: Two clans take turns. The Bard describes the word on each card using ONLY one-syllable words — speak small, win big.

content.title: Overview
content.text:
At the start of the game, players are randomly split into Red Clan and Blue Clan.

Each turn, one player on the active clan volunteers as the Bard. The Bard sees a card and must describe the word or phrase to their teammates using only one-syllable words. Their clan shouts out guesses.

When the clan guesses correctly, the Bard taps the card to score points (1pt for easy cards, 3pts for hard cards). Stuck? Tap PASS for a –1 penalty and move on.

The Bard has 90 seconds to burn through as many cards as possible. After both clans take a turn, the host decides whether to keep playing, reset scores, or end the game.

content.title: Allowed and not allowed
content.text:
Allowed:
• Words with one syllable only
• Any word already said aloud by a teammate
• Any word that's been guessed already this turn

Not allowed:
• Multi-syllable words
• Gestures, miming, or charades
• Sound effects or impressions
• Saying "sounds like" or "rhymes with"
• Initials, abbreviations, or spelling out letters
• Other languages
• Any part of the word or phrase on the card

The honor system applies. If the other clan hears a multi-syllable word, they yell "BAD!" — and the Bard should pass that card for the –1 penalty.

content.title: Scoring
content.text:
Each card is worth 1 point (easy) or 3 points (hard) — the value is shown on the card.

Pass = –1 point. Don't pass too quickly!

At the end of the game, the clan with the highest combined score wins.

content.title: End of round
content.text:
After both clans have taken a turn, all the cards from that round become inspectable. Click the eye icons on the decks to browse what came up — perfect for table-talk and ribbing.

When everyone's done, the host clicks any deck to advance, then votes: Keep scores, Reset scores, or End game.
